definitions.gloss: round slices; cutting into circles; cross-section cut
definitions.explanation: A cutting technique where cylindrical ingredients are sliced perpendicular to their length, creating circular slices. The most basic and intuitive way to cut cylindrical vegetables.

examples.japanese: きゅうり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輪切|わぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cut the cucumber into round slices.

examples.japanese: ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輪切|わぎ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧5mm⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輪切|わぎ}りにして⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧。
examples.english: Cut the carrot into 5mm round slices and simmer.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{輪|わ}→輪：02142_wa⟧ (ring, circle) + {切|ぎ}り (cutting)

Literally "ring cutting" - creates circular slices.

CUTTING TECHNIQUE:
Hold the ingredient horizontally and cut straight down at regular intervals. Works best with cylindrical ingredients.

COMMON INGREDIENTS:
- きゅうり - cucumber
- ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧ - carrot
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ - daikon
- なす - eggplant
- ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧ - lemon
- ⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧ - banana

COMMON PATTERN:
「〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輪切|わぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧」 - to slice ~ into rounds

THICKNESS VARIATIONS:
- ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧{輪切|わぎ}り - thin round slices
- ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧{輪切|わぎ}り - thick round slices

RELATED CUTTING TERMS:
- ⟦{半月切|はんげつぎ}り→半月切り：08091_hangetsugiri⟧ - half-moon slices
- ⟦いちょう{切|ぎ}り→いちょう切り：08092_ichougiri⟧ - quarter rounds
- ⟦{斜|なな}め{切|ぎ}り→斜め切り：08090_nanamegiri⟧ - diagonal cut
